messages:
alex_m: Drafting Q2 GPU procurement scenarios — pushed a spreadsheet to #eng-infra-docs. Need a quick call: commit % vs spot fallback for APAC pilot. TL;DR: three options.

anya: Can you paste the matrix here? link to doc would be great.

alex_m: Pasted summary below (full sheet -> #eng-infra-docs):
```
Scenario A: 70% reserved, 30% spot; APAC pilot +2w; cost delta ~-12%; medium operational risk
Scenario B: 40% reserved, 60% spot; APAC pilot day0; cost delta ~-25%; higher preemption risk, needs spot fallback routing
Scenario C: 90% reserved (dedicated); APAC pilot full capacity; cost delta +8%; lowest latency risk, highest $
Fallback plan: automatic routing to EU region + model-variant fallback when capacity throttled
Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3 sprints
Launch criteria: p95 latency <= 220ms, failover rate <0.2%, cost per 1k tokens <= budget threshold
```

dmitri: Important: enterprise customers (FinTech pilot) expect APAC with SLA. If we pick B we might miss SLA. Which customers are gating this?

samira: Ops note: B needs robust preemption handling and warm standby nodes. We should add warm-pool + graceful eviction runbook. Otherwise oncall will be paged constantly.

alex_m: Agreed. Proposed mitigations: autoscale with warm pool (min nodes), graceful fallback to EU region, and model-variant degrade path (quantized model with slightly lower perf). Add routing policy: prefer local until spot loss then route EU.

sylvie: Product perspective: FinTech customer explicitly asked for private VPC in APAC for compliance. Any scenario that doesn't guarantee private deployment readiness won't ship to them. That affects the go/no-go lane.

anya: Cost-signal ask from biz: we need cost-per-request metric at p95 token length (1k tokens) in the matrix so finance can project runway. Can someone add that?

finance: Quick finance constraint: procurement budget cap for Q2 is $1.9M committed spend. Any scenario that pushes projected committed > $1.9M needs exec sign-off.

alex_m: OK — initial recommendation: Scenario A with APAC canary + spot fallback. It keeps committed spend in band and buys us time to add private VPC readiness for the FinTech pilot. Action items: update procurement PO with phased commitment, include clause for private deployment readiness within 30 days of pilot start.

dmitri: Ops will own the runbook: rolling reprovision steps, automated model fallback, and telemetry alerts. I'll draft and post.

samira: I'll prototype the warm-pool k8s setup this week. Example command to seed pool: `kubectl apply -f warm-pool.yaml` then `./scripts/seed-warm-pool --region=apac --count=6`.

anya: Decision deadline: EOD Friday so procurement can lock prices. Voting please: :+1: for Scenario A, :eyes: for B, :-1: for C.

alex_m: Quick tally so far: alex_m :+1, anya :+1, dmitri :eyes, samira :+1, sylvie :-1 (due to private VPC requirement). sylvie can you confirm what would flip to +1?

sylvie: I put -1 because private VPC readiness must be in-scope for the APAC pilot. If Scenario A includes a binding private-VPC readiness clause and a 30-day ramp to full VPC option, I'm +1. Otherwise we risk failing compliance gating.

alex_m: That sounds reasonable. I'll add the private-VPC clause and update the sheet + procurement PR. Next steps: update SLO checklist, publish ops runbook (dmitri), warm-pool prototype (samira), procurement PO update (me) by Monday morning.

anya: Thanks — please post the updated sheet and a one-line summary in this thread when updated. :thumbsup:

finance: Noted budgetwise. If final commit exceeds cap we'll route to execs.

alex_m: Filing action items in tracker and tagging owners. Appreciate the fast feedback.

ops-bot: Reminder: create incident runbook ticket when runbook draft is posted.
